distributions as prior distributions for σ
Figure:
In the grey area, the shooter scores goals
IfσσforHN(σσ)is small, the shooter scores almost every time (left)
IfσσforHN(σσ)is medium, then the shooter scores occasionally
(centre).
IfσσforHN(σσ)is large, then the shot can literally backfire (right)
